answer: The workshop keeps the summit, the ledger keeps the mirror, time itself keeps the meadow — and none of the three works for the farm. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Wanting 548 seats means paying for 548 proofs at 121 POA each, and the 66308 POA is gone before the epoch opens. My check this epoch is Loom master wool cloth mark woven at the loom loft: the applicant brings each wool cloth is a cloth woven beside the maker's mark, or the door stays shut. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
